WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, f.quantity, s.store_id, s.format AS fmt_asof, cs.format AS fmt_cur
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
), ret AS (
  SELECT sales_line_id, count(*) nret, sum(refund_net) refund_net, sum(quantity_returned) qr FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT cs.fmt_cur, count(*) lines, sum(sold.net_amount) sold_net, sum(r.refund_net) refund_net, count(r.sales_line_id) lines_returned, max(r.nret) max_ret_rows,
  sum(CASE WHEN r.qr>sold.quantity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) over_qty, sum(CASE WHEN r.refund_net>sold.net_amount+0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) over_val,
  sum(CASE WHEN fmt_asof<>fmt_cur THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) fmt_diff
FROM sold LEFT JOIN ret r USING (sales_line_id), (SELECT 1) cs(x)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

 sum(CASE WHEN f.net_amount<=0 OR f.quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2

WITH a AS (
  SELECT cs.store_id, cs.format, sum(f.net_amount) fact_net
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2 AND s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY 1,2
), b AS (
  SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales_before_returns) rpt_net FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' AND store_id<900 GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT a.format, count(*) stores, round(sum(fact_net),2) fact_net, round(sum(rpt_net),2) rpt_net, round(sum(fact_net)-sum(rpt_net),2) diff,
  sum(CASE WHEN abs(fact_net-rpt_net)>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) stores_off
FROM a FULL JOIN b USING (store_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, cs.format
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s  ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2
    AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
), refunds AS (
  SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, sold.format,
       ROUND(SUM(sold.net_amount), 2) AS sold_net,
       ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0), 2) AS returned_net,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / SUM(sold.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM sold LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.sales_line_id = sold.sales_line_id
GROUP BY sold.format
ORDER BY sold.format
